description: This file defines a RAGService class which implements a simple Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using TF-IDF vectors for document similarity. It manages a vector store stored as JSON files, allowing adding documents, querying for similar documents, and persistence of the vector store.

classes.name: RAGService
classes.description: A service class for retrieval-augmented generation, managing a vector store and providing search functionality.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the RAGService, loads settings, creates directories, and loads existing vector store data.

methods.name: _persist(self)
methods.description: Saves the current texts and sources to disk in JSON format.

methods.name: _load(self)
methods.description: Loads texts and sources from the JSON file if it exists, rebuilding the vectorizer and similarity matrix.

methods.name: _rebuild(self)
methods.description: Reconstructs the TF-IDF vectorizer and similarity matrix from the stored texts.

methods.name: int add_documents(self, docs: List[Tuple[str, str]])
methods.description: Adds new documents by chunking the text and storing each chunk with its source, then rebuilds and persists the store.

methods.name: List[str] _chunk_text(self, text: str, max_len: int = 800)
methods.description: Splits large text into smaller chunks based on paragraphs and sentences, with a maximum length.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] query(self, query: str, top_k: int = 3)
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for a query, returning the top matching document chunks with scores and sources.
